references.text: Parallel passage in Leviticus that also lists the raven among the unclean birds that should not be eaten, using the same expression 'all kinds of ravnes'
Noah sent out a raven from the ark after the flood, illustrating the raven's role in biblical history
God commanded the ravens to bring food to the prophet Elijah at the brook Cherith, showing God's use of these birds
God asks Job who provides food for the raven, demonstrating God's care for these birds
The psalm praises God who gives food to the animals and to the young ravens that cry out
Jesus mentions the ravens as an example of God's care, noting that they neither sow nor reap, yet God provides them with food
